title: Review: Phantom Blade Zero (PS5) - One of the Generation's Greatest Action Experiences
summary:
I got Soul but I'm not a Soulslike.

Should you ever wonder what it might feel like to be the coolest person on the planet, then Phantom Blade Zero is utterly hell-bent on fulfilling that fantasy.

The western debut from S-GAME makes a punchy, stylish, and deep combat system the nucleus of an adventure full of action and flair. It’s presented with a swagger that leans into pleasure, with an incredible game feel that lends every one of your moves an extreme degree of satisfaction.
